title: [Decision] Implementation cards never carry ADR or skills edits: split governed-text items into their own domain:skills card
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bob · session_012dn2Ae4fomvXPZ2AioCpY4

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (a dispatch-protocol change). The maintainer named it in this seat's session: 「那skills和adr 就应该单独分拆issue才合理啊」, then 「立决策卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: today one bookkeeping line in `docs/adr/**` (or `skills/**`) inside a code card raises the whole build to the ceiling tier at effort `xhigh`. It also turns the whole PR into Tier H, so the code waits for the maintainer's approval although it needs neither. The maintainer pays in approvals, the fleet pays in tokens and in landing time, and a same-card split leaves an orphan PR behind.
Reader who acts: the director seat presents it; once ruled, the `domain:skills` seat lands one text-only PR.
Dedupe (open and closed, `is:issue`): "mixed diff governed split" → 155 hits, nearest #23578 (closed, ruling C: review scope of a mixed diff); "MANDATORY tier docs/adr" → 241 hits, nearest #25729 and #29741 (closed: ADR cards at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER + `xhigh`); "carry note ADR" → 5226 hits, none on the question. None asks whether an implementation card may carry governed-text edits. **New.**

## 维护者速读

- **一句话问题：** 一张写代码的卡，只因为顺带要在 ADR 里补一行「resolved by」,整张卡就被锁到最高模型档 + xhigh,PR 也变成要您逐个批准的受管 PR;而代码本身两样都不需要。
- **选项：** A 维持现状(派出去后席位临时拆)· B 立卡时就拆：实施卡不碰 `docs/adr/**`、`skills/**`,这类条目一律成为独立的 `domain:skills` 卡(ADR 记账行在代码合并后立卡)· C 同卡拆两个 PR。
- **席位推荐：** B。
- **需要你做的：** 选 A、B 或 C。

## Background (the case that raised it)

#31911 (objectql, L) was dispatched at the ceiling tier with `effort: xhigh` because carry note 6760039411 put ADR-0144's D5 "resolved by" line on it. `dispatch-gates --tier` answered "MANDATORY" from the `docs/adr/**` row alone. On the same code paths without the ADR line, it answers that the tier is the PM's per-card call. Mid-flight, the maintainer switched the dev to opus by hand. The seat first split the work into two PRs (amendment 1 on #31911), then moved the line off the card (amendment 2), after the maintainer said 「那skills和adr 就应该单独分拆issue才合理啊」.

## Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈路径分叉〉: 「路径面命中 Tier H ⇒ ACCEPT 换终局四件套,混合 diff ⛔ 不按比例判;要拆让 dev 单独开 PR。」
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB_ROWS`: `docs/adr/**` → `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, `oneLineExit: false` (order of #25729: 「adr 这种任务都需要 fable extra」). The other mandated rows are `SKILL.md`, `os-dev.md` and `skills/**`. No product-code path carries a mandate.
- #29741 (standing order, Warren 2026-11-03): docs-only ADR cards are fixed at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER + `xhigh`; "an ADR+code mixed diff — those still go to a fable decision thread or split per the existing rules". The existing rules do not say *when* or *how* to split.
- Ruling C on #23578 (6184805932): the at-tier review of a mixed diff covers only the `reviewFace` hits; Tier H approval stays whole-PR.
- SKILL.md lane table: `domain:skills` owns `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**`. Claim template: `Skills-docs: updated here` only on `domain:skills` PRs, else `follow-up #N`.
- `references/instrument-discipline.md`: 「`dispatch-gates.mjs` 冻结 … ⛔ 不新增 … `--tier` 强制档」. So every option here is rules text only.
- Protocol change: yes, the dispatch protocol only. No product contract moves.

## Premises, each with a re-check

1. The ADR row mandates the ceiling and has no one-line exit. Run `grep -c "glob: 'docs/adr/\*\*'" scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` → 1. Control: `grep -c "TIER_DEFAULT = 'opus'" scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` → 1.
2. Code paths alone carry no mandate. Run `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts | grep -c MANDATORY` → 0. Adding the ADR-0144 path gives 1.
3. A mixed diff is Tier H as a whole. Run `grep -c "混合 diff ⛔ 不按比例判" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` → 1. Control: `grep -c "## 路径分叉" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` → 1.
4. The tier tool is frozen. Run `grep -c 'dispatch-gates.mjs` 冻结' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md` → 1. Control: `grep -c "仪器纪律" …/instrument-discipline.md` → 1.

(All four measured on `origin/main` `bca2a515`, 2026-11-10.)

## Options

| | 做什么 | 客户/维护者可感知后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | 维持现状：实施卡可夹带 ADR/skills 改动，整卡按上限档施工，PR 整体 Tier H;席位事后临时拆 | 每次夹带都让代码 PR 等您批；上限档消耗在代码上；拆法因席而异 | 0 |
| B | 立卡/认领时就拆：实施卡的文件面 ⛔ 不含 `docs/adr/**`、`skills/**`、`SKILL.md`、`os-dev.md`;这类条目成为独立 `domain:skills` 卡 —— ADR 记账行(resolved by / amended 注记)由落地席位在代码合并后立卡、引合并 commit;skills 文档沿用 `Skills-docs: follow-up #N`;分诊写 carry note 时同样指向「合并后立卡」 | 代码 PR 由席位复核即落地；您只批那张一行的 ADR 卡;ADR 卡照 #25729/#29741 仍是上限档 + xhigh | `domain:skills` · 1 个纯文本 PR(`execution-duties.md` 派发节 + `triage-duties.md` carry note 一行，行数净零守棘轮)· 先例 PR #25780(+33 −11,4 文件) |
| C | 同卡拆两个 PR:代码 PR `Fixes`,ADR PR `Refs` | 代码 PR 一合并卡就关,ADR PR 成孤儿半态；卡的强制档仍按整卡文件面算 | `domain:skills` · 1 个纯文本 PR · 无先例 |

**业务含义直译：**
- A = 每次顺手补一句会议纪要，整份合同都要老板签字。
- B = 合同照常签，纪要单独归档、老板只签纪要。
- C = 两份文件订在一起，合同签完纪要就没人管了。

## 四维分析

- **① 项目长远合理性(领起):** B 让「谁拥有哪个文件」与「谁做哪张卡」一致：域表本就把 `docs/adr/**` 和 `skills/**` 划给 `domain:skills`,实施卡改 ADR 本身就是越界。B 收缩特例(不再需要事后拆、不需要档位例外)。A 把例外留给每个席位临场判断。C 制造孤儿 PR。
  - 终态：两年后，代码卡只按代码定档、由席位复核落地，规范文本(ADR、技能)只由其所属车道写、由您批。主流做法同此：变更记录/ADR 状态由文档 owner 维护，不随功能 PR 夹带(参照 CODEOWNERS 分属与 ADR 「superseded/resolved」记账惯例)。
- **② 实际业务拉动：** 今天就撞上了：#31911(L 卡)因一行 ADR 记账被锁上限档，您亲手切模型。carry note 是分诊的常规写法(检索「carry note ADR」命中大量卡)，会反复发生。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错：** B 是结构性的：认领文件面不许混写，席位与 dev 都没有「顺手改 ADR」的余地，ADR 只由上限档在专卡里写。出错时谁看到什么：A 下,AI 用上限档写代码不会更错，但会用代码卡的上下文顺手写 ADR,错了要您在大 PR 里找；B 下 ADR 错误只出现在一行的专卡上，您一眼可见。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散：** B 不新增门禁、不碰冻结的 `dispatch-gates.mjs`,只改两行规则文本(净零行)。代价是多立一张小卡，按需产生。

os-decision-facets
① 长远合理性：B 缩小特例 —— 文件归属与卡归属一致，取消事后拆分与档位例外;A 维持临场判断;C 新增孤儿 PR 半态。
② 业务拉动：#31911 今天撞上(一行 ADR 记账锁住 L 卡上限档，维护者手动切模型);carry note 指向 ADR 是分诊常规写法，会复发。
③ 防 AI 犯错：B 结构性禁止实施卡写规范文本，ADR 只在专卡由上限档写、维护者一行可审;A/C 依赖临场判断。
④ 不扩散：B 无新门禁、不碰冻结工具，纯文本净零行;C 同量但留半态;A 零改动但持续付审批与档位成本。
Prior rulings read: tier,ceiling,governed,adr → 254 hits; ADR none on point (top hits are spec-schema prose); rulings on point: #23578 C (6184805932, review scope), #25729 order, #29741 standing order — B keeps all three; thread: none

## Recommendation

**B.** Confidence gap: the ADR bookkeeping line can be forgotten once the code has merged. Mitigation, inside B: the landing seat records it at ACCEPT as an Acceptance note with `carrier:` and files the card in the same round. That is the existing rule that owed follow-ups are filed (`filing-gate.md`: 「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」).
- A is not taken: it keeps paying a ceiling build and a whole-PR approval for one bookkeeping line, and the split stays at each seat's discretion.
- C is not taken: `Fixes` closes the card at the code merge, which leaves the ADR PR as an orphan half-state, and the card-level tier mandate still applies.

Self-check: only ① reads B. Do ②③④ flip it? No.

## After the ruling (B)

1. **One `domain:skills` PR, text only, Tier S (`.claude/**`):**
   - `references/execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉 gains: an implementation card's declared file surface never includes `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `SKILL.md` or `os-dev.md`; such items become their own `domain:skills` card, and ADR bookkeeping is filed by the landing seat after the merge, citing the merge commit.
   - `references/triage-duties.md` gains: a carry note aimed at those paths names "filed post-merge by the landing seat", never the implementation card.
   - Net zero lines under `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`; no `dispatch-gates.mjs` change (frozen).
2. #25729 and #29741 stand unchanged: ADR cards stay at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER + `xhigh`.
3. The first application is #31911's ADR-0144 D5 line, already moved off that card by amendment 2.

## Related

#31911 (the case) · #31743 (ADR-0144 amendment) · #23578 · #25729 · #29741 · #32060 (an ADR-notes-only card, the shape B produces) · PR #25780 · PR #23655
